subject: Total Reward Grid: proposed leveling + geo multipliers (review & signoff)
messages:
From: Benchmarking Co <benchmarks@benchmarkingco.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: 2026 pay-market update + geo multipliers (attached)

Hi Mina,

Please find attached our 2026 enterprise software compensation benchmarking. Key highlights relevant to high-growth inference platforms:
- Median pay moved ~6% year-over-year for senior individual contributors (IC4/IC5) in major US markets.
- Stock mix is shifting: earlier-stage companies show higher RSU allocations for mid-senior roles; mature companies are increasing cash tilt for scalability roles.
- Geographic deltas: EU medians ~-5% vs US national, APAC (ex-SG) ~-12% vs US. Singapore is close to US national (~-3%).

Attachments: Benchmarking_2026_raw.xlsx (tabs: US-core, EU-core, APAC-core; percentiles 25/50/75/90).

We included a suggested geo multiplier matrix and a sample leveling mapping to common industry titles. Happy to walk through the workbook live — available next week.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Benchmarking Co
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: FW: 2026 pay-market update + geo multipliers (attached)

Team — forwarding the benchmark packet we commissioned. High-level ask: can we converge on a clean total-reward grid (base + target equity + cash bonus guidance) to use for offers and for new req approvals?

Early read / proposed changes from my side:
- Flatten midbands: merge previous L3a/L3b into single L3 with range tightening to reduce overlap.
- Raise market anchor for L4 (senior engineers) to the 60th percentile for US core hires. Example base ranges (US national): L4 $150,000–$185,000; L5 $190,000–$240,000; L6 $260,000–$330,000.
- Equity targets (annualized grant pacing): L4 0.08%–0.15%; L5 0.15%–0.30%; L6 0.30%–0.60%.
- Geo multipliers proposal (starting point): US 1.00; EU 0.95; UK 0.98; SG 0.97; APAC (ex-SG) 0.88. These are blunt — need your input for country-level nuance.

I attached a draft grid (total_reward_grid_v2.xlsx) with sample offer scenarios and an estimated FY26 run rate impact (~+4.8% for open headcount if adopted at current posting mix).

Please review and send back line edits by EOD Friday so I can package for Finance + Legal before next Tuesday's exec review. If objections to the approach, call it out explicitly (band names, percentile anchor, major geo exceptions).

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: 2026 pay-market update + geo multipliers (attached)

Mina — quick notes after skimming the workbook:
- Agree with flattening bands; overlap creates negotiation headaches.
- On anchors: prefer 75th percentile for L5 hires in SF/Bay Area given scarcity for inference engineers. We could keep US national at 60th but add a location premium table for SF/SEA (they'd get +12% on base).
- Need clarity on total comp vs base for hiring manager approvals — do we require sign-off on total compensation (incl. equity) for offers above the band midpoint?

I attached a short CSV with three real offer examples from Q3 (offer_examples.csv) for modelling. Also, curious about structure for contractor conversions — do we apply the same band or a conversion uplift?

— Jonas
Director, Engineering Recruiting
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: 2026 pay-market update + geo multipliers (attached)

Thanks for pulling this together Mina. I like the cleaner bands and the equity pacing. A few operational flags:
- Finance will need a headcount-level impact analysis before we can greenlight shifting anchors (show by team + quarter). The ~+4.8% run rate needs a breakdown (new reqs vs renewals vs offers for conversions).
- For any upward market adjustments that increase offer PPS (per-person spend) we should specify which roles require an exception to standard hiring approval (e.g., >10% over posting midpoint requires VP HR + Finance sign-off).
- Legal: attach legal_review_notes.pdf — we need to validate equity plan language and any localization clauses for EU.

If you want, I can draft the brief for Finance that calls out scenarios and asks for revised headcount envelopes.

Marissa
VP, People Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated total reward grid + approval request

Team — attached is my consolidated grid (total_reward_grid_v2.xlsx) with the following updates based on your feedback:
- Applied SF/SEA location premium of +12% to base anchors and included explicit examples for L4/L5 offer stacks.
- Added contractor conversion uplift: one-time conversion bonus equal to 5% of annualized target comp plus RSU grant at 50% of role target in year 1.
- Adjusted APAC multipliers after country-level checks: Singapore 0.98, India 0.80, Australia 0.92.
- Drafted approval thresholds: hiring manager can approve offers up to 5% above midpoint; >5%–10% requires Director + Finance; >10% requires VP HR + Finance + CEO notice. (This is prescriptive to reduce offer-side delays.)

Workday impact: apply grid to open reqs listed below (these will be the first wave). I estimate the FY26 incremental comp spend if grid adopted and 100% hiring of open reqs at ~+$1.15M.
- REQ-2026-1147 (Backend infra eng)
- REQ-2026-1159 (Inference runtime)
- REQ-2026-1163 (SRE)

Attachments: total_reward_grid_v2.xlsx, offer_examples.csv, legal_review_notes.pdf

Requesting signoff from Marissa (People Ops) + Laura (Finance) by COB Wednesday so I can post the new bands and update offer templates Thursday morning. If no objection, I'll push to Workday and notify recruiting.

— Vivek
SVP, Product & GTM Ops
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated total reward grid + approval request

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. I approve the proposed thresholds and the country adjustments Vivek added. Next steps:
1) Marissa — please send the Finance brief (line-item run rate) and include the headcount wave breakdown.
2) Laura — if you can confirm Fund/Cost center mapping for the three REQs and OK the +$1.15M impact, I will instruct HRIS to stage the grid in Workday.
3) Jonas — recruiting will adopt the SF premium stack immediately for posted reqs once we have a green light from Finance.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync Friday to walk through the Drive workbook and answer any final questions before public rollout.

Mina
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
